description: Create a defect or maintenance ticket on an item. The organization's default assignee rules apply automatically — the assignee is emailed straight away. Optionally set the item's status in the same call via setItemStatus (like the web report form: defect reports usually also mark the item "defect"). State a one-sentence summary — what the ticket says and, when you pass setItemStatus, that the item's condition changes with it — and get your user's OK BEFORE calling. Recommended: pass a fresh `clientRequestId` (e.g. a UUID) with every new ticket — retrying with the SAME id returns the existing ticket instead of creating a duplicate.

clientRequestId.description: Optional but recommended: a unique id you generate for this request (e.g. a UUID). If the call times out or you retry, pass the SAME id — you'll get the existing ticket back instead of creating a duplicate. Use a fresh id for each new ticket.

setItemStatus.description: Also set the item's condition in the same operation. Omit to leave the item status unchanged. For other status changes use set_item_status.

name: create_ticket
title: Create ticket
